Chapter 1155: Chapter 19: Birth of the Treasure (Bonus Update, Seeking Monthly Votes at the Start of the Month)

Internal Universe.

The red-clad girl stood beside the jade gourd, also observing the changes in time and space around her.

As the spirit of the Jade Gourd, with Lin Yuan’s permission, the red-clad girl could immediately sense the subtle differences in the internal universe before and after.

“The second layer is complete.”

The red-clad girl mused, the process of cultivating “Infinite Void” was akin to the subtle transformation of the internal universe, perfecting its microstructure.

The same fundamental particles, through different structuring methods, ultimately display vastly different powers.

“This second layer of ‘Infinite Void’ is almost reaching the third layer, Infinite Void,” the red-clad girl thought.

Normally, the second layer of “Infinite Void” could only push the internal universe to the level of a Chaos Great Saint’s internal universe, but the current internal universe is far beyond just matching a Chaos Great Saint’s internal universe.

“What opportunity did the master obtain to elevate the internal universe to this extent?”

The red-clad girl was quite curious, reaching new heights from a tall pole? It’s very hard, especially since “Infinite Void” has nearly pushed the internal universe to its limits.

To further enhance the strength of the internal universe? Only the red-clad girl knew how difficult it was.

Hua!

Lin Yuan’s consciousness avatar descended.

“Master.” The red-clad girl jumped up, looking at Lin Yuan: “The universe has transformed completely.”

“Hmm…”

Lin Yuan nodded, closing his eyes to carefully experience the vast and boundless internal universe.

It’s like a plain piece of carbon, transformed into a brilliant diamond due to changes at the microstructural level.

At this moment, a similar change occurred in Lin Yuan’s internal universe. The essence remained unchanged, but the microstructure was completely renewed.

“The universe’s limit has been elevated by a significant margin.”

Lin Yuan immediately sensed an intense hunger from the root of the internal universe.

“Devour, devour.”

Lin Yuan immediately brought out vast resources, allowing the origin source of the internal universe to consume them.

This journey to the Xuanhuang Universe, even without being concluded, Lin Yuan had reaped tremendous gains, making it not at all difficult to satisfy the internal universe’s hunger.

Rumbling.

With the support of vast resources, the internal universe started expanding frenziedly again.

One hundred billion light years.

Two hundred billion light years.

Five hundred billion light years.

Eight hundred billion light years.

…

Only when approaching the trillion-light-year range did it gradually slow down.

The internal universe within the trillion-light-year range, in terms of size, has already completely rivaled the naturally-born universe nurtured by the Chaos Void; a Chaos Venerable’s internal universe is only several hundred billion light years in size.

It must be noted, Lin Yuan’s internal universe, unlike other Chaos Realm internal universes, doesn’t pursue size but quality.

It’s like comparing a block of tofu with a silver needle.

In terms of size, the former crushes the latter.

But a silver needle can easily penetrate the tofu.

The Thirteen-tier inheritance “Infinite Void” also reconstructs the microstructure of the internal universe, not specifically to increase the universe’s area.

…

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan gazed into the deepest part of the universe, where a cosmic sun was blazing intensely, its radiance illuminating the entire universe.

This cosmic sun could only be seen by Lin Yuan, deliberately hidden from the red-clad girl.

“The transformation of the internal universe has caused this cosmic sun source to also transform.” Lin Yuan thought to himself as he watched the cosmic sun source.

It is evident that after mastering the second layer of “Infinite Void,” the cosmic sun source itself became stronger.

“Indeed, as the cosmic sun source has now completely integrated with the internal universe, becoming a part of it, the improvement of the internal universe naturally leads to the advancement of the cosmic sun source.”

Lin Yuan thought silently.

Currently, Lin Yuan’s internal universe gathers two great thirteen-tier methods.

One is “Infinite Void,” and the other is “Raging Sun Genesis.”

…

“My current internal universe, although only covering a trillion light years, is enough to rival those of ten trillion or a hundred trillion light years. Such internal universes are close to those of Absolute Saints.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The power operating within the internal universe at this moment was so mighty that Lin Yuan felt a shiver, so powerful that it transcended the average Chaos Great Saint’s strength.

Perhaps there was still a gap with an Absolute Saint, but it could almost sweep across the level of Chaos Great Saints.

“Master, how do you feel now?” the red-clad girl couldn’t help but ask from the side.

“Very good.” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

He felt an unprecedented strength, even a sense that, if he fully unleashed it, he could break free of the Xuanhuang Universe’s suppression.

Of course, even if this feeling were real, Lin Yuan wouldn’t do it; it would be entirely thankless. Breaking free from the Xuanhuang Universe would cause the entire universe to collapse prematurely.

This would not bring even the slightest benefit to Lin Yuan.

The longer the Xuanhuang Universe exists, even under the circumstances of space-time collapse, it can continuously nurture Xuanhuang Beasts, providing resources for Lin Yuan’s cultivation of the “Body of Xuanhuang.”

“More than just very good.” The red-clothed girl blinked her eyes, “The inner universe transformed by the second layer of ‘Infinite Void’ makes the master the absolute first among all previous cultivators, and far ahead of the second.”

Among the previous cultivators of “Infinite Void,” there were those who reached the third or even fourth layer.

But speaking of the second layer, no one could compare to Lin Yuan.

“The previous cultivators of ‘Infinite Void’?”

Lin Yuan was not surprised; the thirteen-stage legacy of “Infinite Void” is extremely ancient and surpasses him as its sole cultivator.

Before Lin Yuan, over the long years, there were also many cultivators of this legacy.

However, once these cultivators died or advanced to the thirteenth stage, the red-clothed girl would take the jade gourd and leave, appearing randomly at any place in the Chaos Void.

Because the red-clothed girl is not a real living being, she can also enter the universe.

When Lin Yuan swept through the Milky Way Star Region and acquired the jade gourd, this thirteen-stage legacy bearer had already stayed in the home universe for several hundred Cosmic Eras.

…

“The master is now only at the Dominator Realm; the inner universe still has much room for improvement,” the red-clothed girl continued.

First, upon entering the Chaos Realm, the inner universe will undergo a qualitative transformation, and the same will happen when the Chaos Realm is perfected. As a Great Saint, the inner universe will continue to evolve.

Moreover, the third, fourth, and fifth layers of “Infinite Void” will all bring qualitative changes to the inner universe.

As for the sixth layer? It is merely a theoretical boundary evolved by the creator of “Infinite Void.” At most, previous cultivators reached the fifth layer; none have ever touched the sixth layer.

“The sixth layer, created by the former master, will transform the inner universe into an existence comparable to the Chaos Void, and this differs greatly from the fifth layer.”

“So it’s almost impossible to reach.”

The red-clothed girl looked at Lin Yuan.

Under normal circumstances, even reaching the fifth layer of “Infinite Void” would mean the inner universe is only tens or hundreds of thousands times stronger than an ordinary Great Saint’s inner universe.

Compared to the entirety of the Chaos Void? It is like a firefly compared to the Bright Moon.

Crossing from one to two isn’t hard, but leaping from one to millions in a single bound is as difficult as ascending to the heavens.

But Lin Yuan is different. Based on his current growth speed and inner universe foundation, when Lin Yuan cultivates to the perfection of the Chaos Realm and adds the fifth layer of “Infinite Void,” the inner universe will grow far beyond the conventional fifth layer level.

This reduces the gap with the Chaos Void, naturally increasing the possibility of advancing to the sixth layer.

“The sixth layer is too far away from me.” Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, not thinking too much of it.

…

The ‘Fragment World’ of Star Tears.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyin Primordial Spirit sat cross-legged, and at the moment when the true self cultivated the second layer of “Infinite Void,” the inner universe of the Taiyin Primordial Spirit naturally reached the second layer.

Regarding the transformation of the inner universe, both the true self and the avatar proceed simultaneously.

Lin Yuan slightly activated the power of the inner universe and found that the principles of the Chaos Void began to retreat from him, centering on his presence.

“It’s said that a Great Saint can, if they wish, create an area where rules are self-established. Am I now half achieving that?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Although a Great Saint is also at the perfection of the Chaos Realm, their path holds great potential, allowing them to surpass the Chaos Great Saints.

By taking their path as the foundation, many principles can retreat, forming a domain where they establish the rules.

Like the Postnatal Universe created by the Great Saints, this is the principle. However, the range of a Postnatal Universe is larger, and maintaining its rules demands much effort from the Great Saints.

Lin Yuan slowly restrained his aura and glanced at the countless humans in the Fragment World, including the nine supreme beings, none of whom noticed Lin Yuan’s gaze.

Let alone discovered that Lin Yuan’s real strength has reached the extent of dominating the Chaos Great Saints.

…

Xuanhuang Universe.

After getting slightly familiar, Lin Yuan began attempting to cultivate the third layer of “Infinite Void.”

“Infinite Void” has a total of six layers, strictly speaking five layers. Each layer involves a distinctly different microscopic transformation of the inner universe, and the third layer of “Infinite Void” has already begun transforming the time-space Origin Source of the inner universe.

“The cultivation time for this layer is estimated to be not short.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself silently.

He had no worries, for what he had most now was time. Those ancient Great Saints have passed through hundreds or thousands of Chaos Eras, basically having no other pursuits, so they chose to attack the thirteenth stage.

After all, the Chaos Great Saints cannot advance further. As for promoting to the Great Saint? It’s determined by the path; it can be achieved or not at all.

Just as Lin Yuan was both cultivating the third layer of “Infinite Void” and continuing towards the depths of Xuanhuang Universe.

Buzz!

A significant spatial-temporal fluctuation came from afar, rapidly spreading throughout more than half of the Xuanhuang Universe.

“Is it… that place?”

Lin Yuan gazed far at the source of the spatial-temporal fluctuation, his expression subtly changing.
